name: SkyPulse Arcade
subtitle: Flight & Signal Heist Puzzles
promotionalText: Three free offline modes: endless flight, daily crystal gates and 3D Signal Heist. Train and breed your flock. Created by Mcaulee Maddison.
description:
SkyPulse Arcade, by Mcaulee Maddison at MacWebStudio (macwebstudio.com), combines mechanical-bird flight and signal-routing puzzles in three free offline modes.

ENDLESS ROUTE
Tap to flap, clear pipe openings and collect crystals as you chase your best. Explore twelve 3D worlds from Neon City to Polar Glow, changing every 15 gates before the route repeats. Themed metal pipes feature animated LED inlays. Mechanical birds have full tap-driven wing strokes, smooth banking and engine trails.

Seven pickups include shielding, time slowing, crystal attraction, bonus crystals and route guides. Supply Cache grants five crystals. Gate Link rewards the next three clean gate passes.

PULSE RELAY
Fly four fresh daily circuits through an orbital station. Collect both randomly placed crystals for each numbered gate. The first charges half its ring; at 2/2 the red lasers turn blue and the gate unlocks automatically. Missing crystals leave it locked. Fly through hollow 3D hoops at varying heights, avoid the runway and reach the green exit. Choose Next Mission after a clear. Four circuits refresh each UTC day; today’s routes and medals stay consistent across restarts.

BLACKOUT PROTOCOL
Restore eight systems through eight increasingly demanding Signal Heist vaults. Tap prisms to rotate mirrors and route live energy on a raised 3D optical console. Power every core and the uplink together. Splitters divide beams; powered relays open matching shutters. Turns cost 1 trace, or 3 with a lit red sensor. Use PLAN to inspect the next rotation, beam path and exact cost without spending, then confirm or return to live play. Clear a vault to save its medal, restore a system and activate the next puzzle immediately. Restart a failed attempt or return to a saved unfinished configuration.

BUILD YOUR FLOCK
Unlock 15 founder birds with combinations of collection, salvage, perfect-pass, distance and recovery rewards for Endless Route. Train birds up to level 5 within your Core’s limit. Each completed training level adds 2% off future founder-bird unlocks, up to 20%, alongside stronger reward traits. Preview the next bird’s exact saving before training.

At Core level 2, choose two owned parents to breed. Preview inherited traits and the crystal cost before confirming. Both parents stay; a permanent offspring joins the Hangar and is equipped. Level 3+ parents can pass stronger grades within the Core’s limit. Duplicate owned combinations cannot charge again. Every bird retains the same flight handling and collision rules. Bird reward traits apply to Endless; your Relay bird is a cosmetic choice.

CORE & TECH
Evolve the central SkyPulse Core through Ion, Jade, Prism, Solar and Nova, each with a distinct colour and halo. Core levels raise training limits and lineage capacity. Levels 2–5 reduce Tech Tree, training and breeding prices by 5%, 10%, 15% and 20%. Core evolution has its own cost.

Drag through one connected 3D holographic Tech Tree. Twelve upgrade families each offer three clearly marked Installed, Next and Locked levels. Inspect the exact effect and final price before purchasing. Pulse Matrix extends timed pickups; Supply Decoder and Link Reactor increase their rewards. The run report separates bird rewards from Tech bonuses.

DAILY MISSION CONTROL
Complete four tasks and claim five crystals each, up to 20 daily-task crystals per UTC day. The reset time appears in your local time zone.

YOUR NEXT MOVE, EXPLAINED
Home starts on Endless Route. Tap its top-left badge to select a mode, each with its own Home, progress and relevant controls. HOW TO PLAY covers flight, Tech, Core evolution, training and breeding, with the complete Worlds & Power-ups map. Blackout has its own puzzle guide and vault map.

Portrait play on iPhone and iPad, with pause, retry, Main Menu, Reduced Motion, sound and haptic settings. Play offline with no advertising, account or real-money purchases. Progress and preferences are saved on your device.
